title: Luxuriant Creamy French Pork Casserole
description: A rich and comforting French dish featuring tender pork, pickles, and a creamy sauce, perfect for a cold winter's night. This flexitarian-friendly recipe is pressure-cooked to perfection.
instructions: Heat the butter in a large skillet over medium heat until melted.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are softened and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the pork cubes and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the sliced pickles and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Sprinkle the flour over the pork mixture and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the pork mixture to a pressure cooker and add the heavy cream.
Close the lid and cook on high pressure for 20 minutes.
Let the pressure release naturally for 10 minutes, then quick-release any remaining pressure.
Stir in the shredded gruyere cheese until melted and smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
Note: this recipe is for refrigerator pickling/preserving only — store in the refrigerator and consume within 1 week. Do not water-bath can without an acid (vinegar or lemon juice).
